text: What if five of the six happiest countries on Earth became one country,
erase the borders between Denmark, Norway, Sweden, Finland, and Iceland,
and you get the seventh biggest country on the planet?
Well, about half of it is ice.
Only 28 million people. That's fewer than Texas.
But its economy? Around 2.2 trillion dollars, top 12 on Earth.
And Norway brings the world's biggest piggy bank,
over two trillion dollars. So why has nobody ever done it? Here's the twist they
already did. In 1397 Denmark Norway and Sweden crowned one king in a Swedish
town called Kalmar. That union lasted 126 years and how it ended is the best
part. In 1523 Sweden just walked out. Sweden's national day still marks that
exact date. Still, they've been crossing each other's borders without passports since the 1950s.
So who gets the capital? Stockholm? Oslo? Copenhagen? Helsinki?
So one flag or five? Because seriously.
